intro_add: NovoTech's value-line bead rollers, built in China, add ETB beading machines to 8 ga, RM24 – RM42 deep-throat bead rollers with variable-speed drive for auto body panels, and for round duct the RM18E power beading machine and the LQ15 slitting and bending machine.
points_add: NovoTech value line: ETB beading machines 18 – 8 ga, RM24 / 36 / 42 motorized deep-throat bead rollers
Round duct: RM18E power beading machine, 15 ga; LQ15 slitting and bending machine, 16 ga × 47″

faq_add.q: Which throat depth for auto body panels?
faq_add.a: The throat is how far from the edge of the panel the bead can go: 24″ reaches the centre of a 48″ panel, 36″ and 42″ reach into floor pans, hoods and truck beds. The RM-H models also have a 4″ high throat so formed panels clear the frame. For duct, ends of tanks and edge beads, the 8 – 12″ throat of the ETB beading machines is enough.

set.hero_brand_line: ISITAN machines are made in Turkey by ISITAN Makine — sheet-metal forming machinery since 1959, with European components; NovoTech's value-line bead rollers are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
